opinions.point: Many commenters found Mochiko compelling because her manipulative, morally cold behavior makes her an unusually interesting character.
Several commenters strongly disliked Mochiko and viewed her treatment of others as cruel, exploitative, and deserving of consequences.
Mebuki drew both ridicule and criticism for her poor financial judgment, while some commenters also saw her situation as increasingly tragic.
Yasuko was widely praised as the grounded, compassionate, and sensible character readers wanted to support.
The thread enjoyed the dark comedy around reckless financial behavior but also felt the characters' decisions were becoming difficult to root for.
